description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying {W}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {W}.
When Archaeomancer dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graceful Reprieve from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
